user.title: Set up Daylight Calendar Import
user.description: Choose how Daylight extracts events. Local AI Task works without a Daylight account. For Daylight Cloud, connect and consent in Daylight settings after setup; calendars can be configured before approving events.

byo.title: Use your own AI Task
byo.description: Choose an AI Task entity, a default calendar, and the calendars allowed for reviewed events.

init.title: Daylight Calendar Import options
init.description: Choose the parser provider and optional local AI Task, writable calendars, and Direct IMAP ingestion. BYO requires an AI Task and calendars. Daylight Cloud connection and consent are managed in Daylight settings.

email.title: Direct IMAP
email.description:
⚠️ **Mailbox privacy:** Daylight can read the full contents and supported attachments of every unread, undeleted message in the configured mailbox. We strongly recommend using a dedicated email address or folder used only for calendar imports. [Learn more about mailbox access and privacy]({privacy_url})

Connect a mailbox for Daylight to poll every five minutes. Messages are marked seen only after durable local handling.

error.invalid_auth: The IMAP server rejected the username or password.
error.invalid_mailbox: The configured mailbox could not be selected or explicitly disallows the required \Seen flag change.

error.default_not_allowed: The default calendar must be included in the allowed calendars.

error.invalid_ai_task: Choose an AI Task entity before selecting local AI Task.
error.invalid_calendar: Choose a default and allowed writable calendar before selecting local AI Task.

storage_recovery.title: Daylight import storage needs repair
storage_recovery.description: Daylight could not safely load its local import storage and will not start new import, approval or notification work. The original data is preserved. With Home Assistant stopped, back up the `.storage/daylight_calendar_import.pending_imports` file and any matching `.corrupt.*` file, then restore a known-good backup or repair the original file. Restart Home Assistant or reload Daylight afterward. Keep uncertain writes blocked until you have checked the destination calendar. Do not delete the file or resend sources as a recovery shortcut; this can duplicate calendar events. After a downgrade, restore a compatible integration version. [Recovery guidance]({documentation_url})

hosted_lifecycle.title: Daylight connection needs attention
hosted_lifecycle.description: Automatic connection maintenance needs attention: approval may have expired, an exchange or renewal may be uncertain, or retries reached a safe limit. Open Daylight settings > Daylight Cloud, check and recover the existing connection, and use the owner account portal if reconciliation is required. Automatic maintenance cannot create a new connection or repeat uncertain credential issuance.
